Anika (partnerships): Quick kickoff — creating a single thread for EU-Bridge region go-live with OrbitCloud (HW partner) + ApexSI (SI). Target customer-facing launch window: 2024-11-20 to 2024-11-27. Primary asks: capacity/quota approvals, marketplace listing + SKU, KMS/HSM handoff, SOX/PAR legal review, and a joint press cadence. I’ll collate owners below.
Ken (partner-eng): OrbitCloud confirmed 16x A100s reserved at the Frankfurt colo, delivery ETA week of Nov 4. They can carve out a dedicated pool for us but need a signed capacity PO by Nov 1. I’ve pinged their account lead (cc @OrbitCloud-sales). :white_check_mark:
Diego (infra): For Dedicated we need exact VM SKU and NIC bandwidth for throughput testing. Also will need public marketplace SKU to validate billing integration. Can someone paste the SKU naming convention?
Ken (partner-eng): SKU format will be: ORBIT-EU-BRIDGE-A100-16-DED. I put a draft entry in the marketplace tracker.
Priya (eng-ml): Heads up on ML side — expected steady-state qps = 80 rps, burst to 220 rps during PR. Planning quantized LLM profile (int8) to hit latency SLOs; will request KV cache warm-up. We should set a prewarm window 48h before go-live.
Diego (infra): Noted. I’ll schedule load tests. Can we standardize a test harness? Priya, can you provide a small cURL script we can point at the staging endpoint?
Priya (eng-ml): Yes — will drop a minimal harness in the repo later today. Example call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging-eu-bridge.redwood.dev/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
Ken (partner-eng): ApexSI needs a firm network handoff date for their on-prem connector — they requested Nov 6 for VPN tunnels and initial runbook validation. They’ll also handle the edge-router config.
ApexSI-bot: ApexSI integration checklist updated: VPN tunnel, cert exchange, initial smoke tests. Ticket #APX-448 created.
Alex (security): Clarification: We cannot accept partner-managed KMS for customer keys. For Private deployments we require customer-managed KMS or our HSM integration with explicit attestation. If OrbitCloud is offering a managed KMS, we need an architecture diagram and threat model review before approval.
Ken (partner-eng): Understood — OrbitCloud proposed HSM passthrough, not managed keys. I’ll get the attestation docs.
Julia (legal): For joint announcement we need 3 full business days for legal review on the PR copy and 5 days for any partner-marketing co-branded collateral. Please drop draft language by Nov 8 to be safe. Also need confirmation on any logos/marks use licenses.
TJ (product): We can hold the external PR until Nov 25 if that helps make the cadence post-stability checks. Internal embargo ok earlier. :calendar:
Diego (infra): Marketplace billing test plan: 1) create test SKU in sandbox 2) simulate purchase via partner sandbox 3) validate metering records. Who owns step 2?
Ken (partner-eng): I’ll coordinate with OrbitCloud sales ops to run step 2 the week of Nov 11.
Anika (partnerships): Action items summary (owners / deadlines):
- OrbitCloud PO & capacity sign-off (Ken) — due Nov 1
- VPN + cert exchange (ApexSI + Diego) — target Nov 6
- KMS/HSM attestation docs (Ken + Alex) — due Nov 5
- Draft PR & co-brand copy (Ken + Julia + TJ) — submit by Nov 8
- Load + billing tests (Diego + Ken + Priya) — schedule Nov 11–15
- Prewarm KV cache window (Priya) — Nov 18–19
- Final go/no-go check (all) — Nov 19
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your owner lines. I’ll keep this thread as the Canon of Record and paste updates to the partnerships board.
Diego (infra): Accepting VPN + billing test ownership. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-ml): Accepting prewarm + test harness. I’ll post PR with harness link today. :rocket:
Julia (legal): Will review PR draft once submitted; will flag any IP/partner language.
Alex (security): Will review attestation and run a quick threat-model checklist. Might need a short call with OrbitCloud security.
Ken (partner-eng): Taking PO sign-off and coordinating partner ops. Will share OrbitCloud attestation and PO template by EOD tomorrow.
Anika (partnerships): Great — I’ll update the tracker and schedule a quick sync Fri 10am UTC to clear blockers. If anything pops up before then, update here. Thanks all! :sparkles:
